verdict.rationale: LiteLLM documents an official CLI at docs/proxy/cli. The only evidenced use is launching the proxy server with options such as the worker count (--workers), so it is shown as a server-launch tool rather than an AI-native workflow interface. Missing for 10: evidence of CLI commands beyond starting the proxy (e.g. key, model or team management, or direct completion calls), agent-friendly output modes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The number of worker processes to spin up (uvicorn, gunicorn, or Granian --workers).
